item.title: What is generative AI and where is it taking us?
item.description: #1: AI: It’s a term that gets banded around a lot. But should we be afraid of it? Or does it actually serve to help businesses? Neural Voice founder Jeremy Smith talks past, current and future use of generative AI, its reliability, and how his company is working with a vast range of clients to boost business growth, improve employee satisfaction, and save on costly expenses.

item.title: The Maverick Recruiter: Challenging traditional hiring
item.description: #2: Ever applied for a job and been ghosted? Or asked for constructive feedback, only to be ignored? Or perhaps you work in recruitment, and want to make improvements to your process. In this IDL episode, Maverick Otter founder Dominic Joyce explains why he took on the role of candidate champion, and why it’s vital for companies to make key changes to their recruitment process to drive and engage the candidate experience while making sure they don’t burn bridges that could turn out to be crucial

item.title: Inside Probuild360’s integrated construction model
item.description: #3: In this IDL episode, Kris speaks with Michael Parinchy, Senior Constructions Manager & New Developments Director at ProBuild 360. From domestic projects to contracting and planning, Michael discusses ProBuild 360’s USP and what’s made the construction company it is today, his frustrations around the planning system, and his advice to those working in the industry.

item.title: From Frustration to Innovation: Orchestrating Data Excellence
item.description: #4: In this episode, we dive into the journey of Hugo Lu, CEO of Orchestra, and how his frustration with repetitive data challenges led to creating a groundbreaking solution. Born from 'scratching his own itch', Hugo shares how data observability can transform businesses—helping them gain deeper insights, avoid costly mistakes, make smarter decisions, and even monetise their data.

item.title: Women in Tech: Why Success in Business is Built on The People
item.description: #6: Leading with Grit and Grace: Meet Stephanie Frackowiak, a tech powerhouse who's driving TradeBridge’s innovative solutions with two decades of leadership in the fintech world. Stephanie is living proof that there are no limits when vision meets talent. In this episode, she opens up about her path to the top, how she’s smashing stereotypes, and why women are set to lead the future of tech. Curious how she’s revolutionising the game - stream the podcast now!

From harnessing open banking data to understanding personal budgeting habits, BTR Future is ensuring more people can access the credit they deserve.
